articles.summary: TORONTO, Nov. 05, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Centerra Gold Inc. (TSX: CG) (NYSE: CGAU) (Centerra or the Company) announced today that the Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX) has accepted the renewal of its normal course issuer bid (NCIB) for an additional one-year period. The Company also announced that its Langeloth Metallurgical Facility (Langeloth) has entered into a new $75 million working capital credit facility. Renewal of NCIB The TSX has accepted Centerras renewal of an NCIB to purchase for cancellation up to 19,318,076 common shares of Centerra (Common Shares) during the twelve-month period commencing on November 10, 2026 and ending on November 9, 2027, which represents 10% of the public float. articles.title: Centerra Gold Announces TSX Acceptance of Renewed Normal Course Issuer Bid and New $75 Million Langeloth Credit Facility
